purpose: Local, deterministic retrieval packages for the Kinder Signs visual-preparation MVP.
governance_note: These packages support visual preparation and human review. They do not certify linguistic correctness or publish content.

usage.en: Use during a familiar routine when a child asks for another portion, turn or repetition.
usage.es: Úsalo durante una rutina habitual cuando un niño pida otra porción, turno o repetición.

routine_guidance.en: Use the sign naturally just before offering more food.
routine_guidance.es: Haz el signo de forma natural justo antes de ofrecer más comida.

movement.description: Both hands meet at the fingertips in a small repeated inward movement.
movement.presentation: One clear central pose with a small repeat indicator; a two-pose sequence is also suitable.

candidates.title: Single-pose teaching view
candidates.review_note: Largest hand area and clearest chest-level placement.

candidates.review_note: Start and contact positions are shown as a compact sequence.
